title: With All Your Might! Take a Full-Throttle Break!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! If you're free,
I'd like your help
with something on our day
off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo's got such a serious expression on
her face, I agree to do
what I can.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! Today,
we're getting
the full student's-day-off
experience!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Remember the other night at the
arcade? I've been thinking
about what
those students said.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: I have to run from dawn to dusk, and then they pile up ridiculous amounts of exercises to do on my days off... Is it such a crime to take a break?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I've been shouting at people
without hearing their side of the
story.
Both tonight... and earlier.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You taught me that I should try being
more sympathetic, so I'm giving
it a go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Today, I wanna research the things
students are doing off-campus. I
think
that'll give me insight as to why the pair
broke curfew!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe!
I just want to be a good disciplinary
chair, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All righty,
first up on our list is "looking at
lip gloss."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: WAIT?! What the heck are these colors?! Those are definitely against the dress code!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oh boy... I get the sense I'm in for a weird deep-dive into the teenage psyche...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: S-so that was Madonna's Memory...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I heard students gossiping about it being a "suuuper spicy romance," but what was that?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The way she... A-anyways, it's definitely a bad influence on students! None of that was school-appropriate!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Why would they order the couple's special
at the cafe?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How is sharing a drink even a breaktime
activity? Wouldn't they
rather get their
own?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course! This is important research, so
drink up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our pitstop at the cafe, we resume
the whirlwind tour of teenage
trends, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying this? We're not here to goof
around. I'm trying to understand
the
student body's pastimes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I guess it is kinda, um... I dunno, I looked at makeup and watched a movie, but I still don't get why someone'd break curfew for stuff like this.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I'm not sympathetic
enough?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think she might be getting too caught up
in the details to see the
full picture.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Things... I enjoy?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait! Wait for meee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So games help students get
refreshed and ready for training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The popular games don't seem to be her
thing, but I've still got an
idea up my
sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Kendo Blade? Whoa, they've got a kendo game?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Press up to aim at the helmet, press the
side keys to aim at the
chest... Yeah, this
one looks interesting! You're on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, you got me?! What was that
smokescreen?! I couldn't see
anything!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But that's not how kendo works! You can't just smoke bomb someone! That's cheating!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Mmph... The rules... The game's rules...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Challenge accepted! I'll beat you by your
own rules, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah?! A-again! I was just testing out the
controls!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Noooooo... Gimme one more shot! I swear
I'll get you this round!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Now! HEADSHOT!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got you! I GOT YOUUU! Did you see
that?! I used skills and
everything!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even in a game, I would never lose a match
of kendo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you can try all you want. Let's do a
round of that game over
there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I suddenly feel tired! I haven't
spent this long playing games
in ages.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Y'know, that was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I really got in the zone and enjoyed
myself. Next thing I knew, I'd
forgotten all
about my research and felt like my usual
red-hot self again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's like the rush you get after winning a
bout of kendo! ...And I think now I kinda
get why those students needed a breather
from all the
serious stuff.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What I said the other day... It was
definitely too harsh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know races and training are important,
but there's more to life. I bet
the two of
them had other important things they
wanted to do too...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to you, I was finally able to
see that! I really appreciate
everything
you've done!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm...
I'm gonna try talking things over with
those two again. I can't
promise things'll
work out though...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, y'know what? You're right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's spend another day off together some
time! It'll be a total blast!
Okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This whole snafu ended up being a really
good learning experience
for Bamboo, and
she looks a lot happier for it!
